candidateReference.warning: The Magillah is present and supplies the Foundation discriminator, but footnotes [^2] and [^7] explicitly say the algorithm/version used is part of the date definition and that multiple Hindu methods exist; it does not identify the exact algorithm/version needed to reproduce all dates.

magillah.foundationRule: Hindu: Vikrama year -41,162; Kārttika; lunar day 16; month and day non-leap.
magillah.footnote2: Algorithmic extension is not a unique standard method; the algorithm and version used are part of the date definition.
magillah.footnote7: The Hindu date is proleptic according to the Hindu computation method used here; multiple Hindu methods/rules exist and the result is not a unique agreed conversion.
magillah.footnote11: Signed integer year numbering includes year zero between 1 and -1.
magillah.conclusion: The Magillah gives an exact Foundation anchor and year-zero convention, but does not name or specify the Hindu algorithm/version in enough detail to compute arbitrary Vikrama dates independently.
